directorTakeover.title: Let AI take over the current project
directorTakeover.description: If the basic info is fairly complete, AI can take over automatically from the selected step, either continuing existing progress or rerunning the current step.

section.title: Book-level positioning
section.description: First decide who this book is for, what draws readers in, and what must be delivered early, then let the world, characters and chapters revolve around the same set of promises.

styleAdvice.title: Writing style advice
styleAdvice.description: Confirm the book's narrative flavor, expressive density and style reference so later chapters stay consistent.

bookFramingSection.heading: Readers and reasons to keep reading
bookFramingSection.subtitle: No need for professional planning jargon, just say intuitively who will like it, what they most want to see, and what payoff they get early on.

targetAudience.label: Target readers
targetAudience.placeholder: e.g. readers who love high-pressure urban comebacks, relationship tension and constant hooks

commercialTags.label: Core commercial tags
commercialTags.placeholder: e.g. comeback, strong conflict, high suspense, workplace maneuvering

competingFeel.label: Competing-title feel / familiar reading feel
competingFeel.placeholder: e.g. real workplace pressure with a touch of dark humor and dense relationship tension

sellingPoint.label: The book's core selling point
sellingPoint.placeholder: e.g. every time the protagonist solves a real-world bind, it leverages a bigger web of relationships and interests, keeping readers anticipating the next counterstrike.

first30.label: First 30 chapters promise
first30.placeholder: e.g. the first 30 chapters must show the protagonist securing a phase-one foothold, the core rival surfacing, the first sharp reversal in the relationship line, and make clear the book only gets fiercer from there.

section.title: Continuation source
section.description: In continuation mode, you must specify the upstream novel or knowledge document referenced, and decide whether to inject book-analysis results.

novel.label: In-app novel
novel.summary: Best for continuing from a novel that already exists in the current system.

knowledge.label: Knowledge base document
knowledge.summary: Best for continuing from an externally imported original work, setting compendium or book-analysis document.
